verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say compliance workflows can be automated with custom triggers and actions, and that controls and evidence are monitored, which suggests some automation engine exists. Nothing in the pack explicitly shows users scheduling recurring or cron-style jobs. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/time-based scheduling for workflows, documentation of schedule configuration (frequency, timing), API or agent access to create schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
